- When sentiment is positive (≥0.2) in recent history, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–2% for 1–3 day horizons.
- After a recent price spike (e.g., +3%+ in last 5 days), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +2% above recent peak for next 5 days.
- Model consistently underestimates mean-reverting periods; add 0.5–1.5% upward bias if recent 7-day average is below 30-day moving average.
- For 30-day forecasts, model frequently misses downward momentum; if sentiment is neutral or negative, add 0.5–1.0% downward bias to avoid overconfidence.
- If sentiment history shows no recent positive signals, model tends to be overly optimistic; apply 1–2% downward correction to avoid “sentiment-driven overfitting.”
